title: Missed Appointments on a Self-Pay Visit Package: Tier Reference
content:
For each tier of the Self-Pay Visit Package, this reference shows whether a missed appointment funded by the package costs a package visit, how many missed appointments per package are not forfeited, and whether a forfeited visit comes back when the missed appointment qualifies for a waiver.

| Tier | Late cancellation or no-show forfeits one package visit (instead of a fee) | Missed appointments per package not forfeited | Forfeited visit restored on a qualifying waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Core 8-Visit Package | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | No | 0 | Yes |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | Yes | 2 | Yes |

**Notes on the columns**

1. *Forfeits one package visit* — whether a late cancellation or no-show on an appointment funded by the package forfeits one package visit instead of a fee.
2. *Not forfeited* — the number of missed appointments per package that are not forfeited.
3. *Restored on a qualifying waiver* — whether a forfeited visit is restored when the missed appointment qualifies for a clinic closure, telehealth failure or documented-emergency waiver.

The Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package is the one tier on which a missed appointment does not forfeit a package visit. The Comprehensive 24-Visit Package carries the largest allowance, 2 missed appointments; the Starter 4-Visit Package carries none.
